query: I just picked up the most adorable rescue kitten from the shelter this morning, she’s a tiny tabby with white paws and she keeps curling up in my jacket pocket while I walk around. The café I stopped at for lunch had the best lavender latte I’ve ever tasted, they even added a little edible flower on top that looked almost too pretty to eat. I was also really excited to find a small bookstore around the corner that had that out of print poetry collection I’ve been searching for over a year now. But anyway, I’m currently abroad and I have roaming turned off, I already exceeded my data usage limit, I also turned off both permissions for the app I’m trying to use, and airplane mode is switched on right now, but the app won’t load at all, can you help me figure out what’s wrong?
